extension.description: Unofficial, experimental coding agent that uses your signed-in M365 Copilot through Edge to read, edit and delete files in a VS Code workspace.
command.open: M365 Agent: Open in Secondary Sidebar
command.connect: M365 Agent: Connect / Sign In to Copilot
command.checkWorkspace: M365 Agent: Check Project Read/Write Access
command.syncWeb: M365 Agent: Sync Current Web Conversation
command.refreshModels: M365 Agent: Load Web Model List
command.editorBrowser: M365 Agent: Switch to VS Code Browser
command.mcpTools: M365 Agent: Select Lookup MCP Tools
config.language.description: Display language for the M365 Code Agent UI, messages, and notifications.
config.experimental.modelProvider.maxPro: Web request character limit for the experimental model provider. Separate from the Webview limit. Old completed exchanges may be omitted while retaining System instructions, all user requests, the latest tool exchange, and tool definitions. The actual web input box limit takes precedence.
config.experimental.modelProvider.enable: Exposes the experimental M365 Web model in the VS Code model picker. Requires signing in again in a separate dedicated browser. Webview hash verification, edit range checks, and undo do not apply to VS Code tools, which follow VS Code approval policies.
config.copilotUrl.description: Web URL of your company M365 Copilot or Code Assistant agent.
config.browserChannel.description: Browser installed on your PC. No separate browser extension is required.
config.maxRounds.description: Safety limit of Copilot requests per task. Default is 100, maximum is 500. Stops before the limit if identical reads, failures, or command results repeat without new outcomes. User-configured values are preserved. Does not apply when Unlimited requests is enabled.
config.responseTimeoutSeconds.descriptio: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a Copilot response.
config.loginTimeoutSeconds.description: Time in seconds to wait for sign-in/MFA and composer readiness while holding the first request. Automatically sends once ready.
config.modelButtonSelector.description: CSS selector for the web model selection button when auto-detection fails. Offers only models actually displayed in the menu.
config.maxPromptCharacters.description: Maximum character count for a request sent to the web. Automatically reduces context before sending if the input box limit is smaller.
config.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum size (MB) of text files to read and partially edit locally. Only required ranges are sent to the web.
config.commandOutputEncoding.description: Command output encoding and Windows code page. Set to cp949 when running CP949-only tools.
config.composerSelector.description: CSS selector for the Copilot input box when auto-detection fails.
config.sendButtonSelector.description: Optional: CSS selector for the send button. When empty, automatically detects the button and verifies submission.
config.responseSelector.description: Optional: CSS selector for the Copilot response container.
config.browserView.description: Where to display the Copilot browser. editor shows the actual automated browser screen in a VS Code editor tab. Use external in environments that require external authentication windows.
config.attachmentMaxFileSizeMB.descripti: Maximum size (MB) of a single original image, document, or video file. The actual Copilot web upload limit takes precedence.
config.attachmentMaxTotalSizeMB.descript: Maximum total size (MB) of original attached files selected in one request. Videos extract and upload 3 scenes locally.
config.attachmentTimeoutSeconds.descript: Wait time in seconds to confirm attachment upload completion on the Copilot screen.
config.attachmentInputSelector.descripti: CSS selector for the Copilot local file upload input[type=file] when auto-detection fails.
config.attachmentButtonSelector.descript: CSS selector for the Copilot local file attachment menu button when auto-detection fails.
config.attachmentReadySelector.descripti: CSS selector for the attachment card inside the composer showing the uploaded file name.
config.attachmentErrorSelector.descripti: CSS selector for file upload error messages inside the composer.
config.attachmentScopeSelector.descripti: CSS selector for the Copilot authoring area containing the composer, attachment cards, and upload status. Do not include conversation history.
